bio: Located in the village centre, this delightful inn has an inviting and cosy atmosphere. Pale wood panelling and finishings lend the spruce interior a rustic charm, and the covered garden is a popular spot during the warmer months. The food is regional and seasonal – options range from hearty classics such as Rahmbeuscherl (veal lights ragout) or Backhenderl (breaded fried chicken) to a more sophisticated set menu....
